# Double <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Types](Language-Features-Types)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Double(value)
Double:Float64(value)
```

**Returns:** The Double.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a Double, a 64-bit real with about 16 digits. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals only know `Int` and `Float`. A Double is calculated with as a Double, so it keeps digits that a `Float` loses, and the math commands ([Sqr](Sqr), [Sin](Sin), [Floor](Floor) and the others) give a Double when they are given one.

## Differences

* Not in the originals, which only have the 32-bit real (`Float`).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
x:Double = Double(1) / 3
Print x * 3
Print Float(x) * 3 = 1
Print Double(Long(5000000000)) + 1 = 5000000001
```

```text
1.0
1
1
```
